# Microsoft Support

> Comprehensive support hub for Microsoft products including Microsoft 365, Windows, Surface devices, and AI-powered tools like Copilot.

Microsoft Support provides official documentation, how-to guides, troubleshooting resources, and account management tools for all Microsoft products and services. The site covers enterprise productivity tools, consumer devices, cloud services, and emerging AI features across multiple platforms.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft 365
- Windows 11
- Microsoft Teams
- Copilot AI
- OneDrive
- Outlook
- Microsoft account
- Office apps
- Surface devices
- Getting started
- Troubleshooting
- Account setup
- Product installation
- Windows activation
- Microsoft Store

## Microsoft 365 & Office Apps

- [Microsoft 365 help & learning](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365): Central support hub for Microsoft 365 products, subscriptions, and Office apps
- [Outlook help & learning](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/outlook): How-to guides and training for Outlook email, calendar, and productivity features
- [Microsoft Teams help & learning](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/teams): Tutorials and support for Microsoft Teams meetings, chat, calls, and Copilot
- [OneDrive help & learning](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/onedrive): Guides for OneDrive file backup, sharing, syncing, and cloud storage management
- [OneNote help & learning](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/onenote): How-to articles for OneNote note-taking, Copilot integration, and handwriting
- [Download, install, or reinstall Microsoft 365 or Office 2024 on a PC or Mac](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/download-install-or-reinstall-microsoft-365-or-office-2024-on-a-pc-or-mac-4414eaaf-0478-48be-9c42-23adc4716658): Installation and activation guide for Microsoft 365 and Office 2024
- [Sign in to Microsoft 365](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/sign-in-to-microsoft-365-b9582171-fd1f-4284-9846-bdd72bb28426): Instructions for signing in to Microsoft 365 and Office apps across platforms

## Windows & Devices

- [Windows help and learning](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows): Support for Windows 11/10 installation, updates, security, and AI features
- [Surface help & learning](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/surface): Setup, troubleshooting, updates, and warranty support for Surface devices
- [Microsoft PC accessories help & learning](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/pc-accessories): Support and troubleshooting for Microsoft mice, keyboards, and accessories

## AI & Copilot

- [Microsoft Copilot help](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot): Getting started and feature guides for Microsoft Copilot AI assistant

## Account & Billing

- [Account help](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/account): Microsoft account setup, security, password recovery, and authentication
- [Microsoft Store & billing help](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-store-and-billing): Billing support for Microsoft Store purchases, subscriptions, and refunds
- [Hardware protection, warranty, and repair](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/warranty): Warranty terms, status checks, and protection plans for Microsoft devices

## Learning & Communities

- [Education help & learning](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/education): Microsoft Education resources for students, educators, and classroom management
- [What's new](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/whats-new): Latest features and updates for Microsoft 365, Windows, Surface, and Edge

## Product Directory & Navigation

- [Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us): Main support hub for Microsoft products including Microsoft 365, Windows 11, and Copilot
- [All Products](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/all-products): Directory of all Microsoft products and services with support links

## Optional

- [Moving from Skype to Microsoft Teams Free](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/moving-from-skype-to-microsoft-teams-free-3c0caa26-d9db-4179-bcb3-930ae2c87570): Migration guide for transferring Skype accounts to Microsoft Teams Free
- [Product safety guidelines](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/surface/cbc47825-19b9-4786-8088-eb9963d780d3): Product safety warnings and incident reporting for Surface, Xbox, HoloLens
